title: PIXL 8000 Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Juicy Peach delivers a smooth, sweet flavour that captures the taste of ripe summer Peaches. Simple, juicy and fragrant — this one’s all about soft fruit satisfaction. The pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and connects to a 10ml refill reservoir. With the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, it offers up to 8000 puffs. Mesh coil tech ensures smooth flavour all the way through. Designed for draw-activated MTL vaping with Boost Mode available, Juicy Peach is an easygoing and popular choice from the PIXL 8000 range.
